name: Chao Li-hua
bio: Chao Li-hua is dated by Giles to the 16th century AD. Her poem here is a lover’s plea.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: To an Absent Lover
poems.author: Chao Li-hua
poems.text:
Your notes on paper rare to see,
Two flying joy-birds bear;
Be like the birds and fly to me,
Not like the paper rare!
